# Swell

> Swell makes ready-to-drink protein shakes and protein smoothies. The shakes taste like milkshakes. Each 14 fl oz bottle has 25g protein and far less sugar than a typical milkshake, plus collagen peptides and colostrum. Sold as single bottles or 12-packs.

## Key facts
- Product: ready-to-drink protein shake (RTD), 14 fl oz (414 mL) bottle
- Protein: 25 g per bottle, milk-protein base
- Added ingredients: collagen peptides, colostrum
- Shake flavors: Cookies & Cream, Cake Batter, Chocolate, Vanilla
- Protein smoothies: creamy fruit taste, 25 g protein, less sugar, 14 fl oz; flavors Pina Colada, Mango, Berry Bliss
- Formats: single bottle, 12-pack
- Contains milk
- Compared with fairlife: fairlife Core Power has 26 g protein per 14 fl oz and fairlife nutrition plan has 30 g per 11.5 fl oz; neither lists collagen peptides or colostrum. Swell is not affiliated with fairlife.
- Compared with a milkshake: a medium fast-food chocolate shake has about 650 calories, 85 g sugar and 15 g protein
- Ninja Creami: pour a bottle into a pint, freeze 24 hours, spin on Lite Ice Cream
- Origin: started as frozen smoothie cubes sold from vending machines in high schools, gyms and hotels
- Status: launching soon; waitlist open
